title: Glider Phase-Class Extractor
input: BT1874 larger-ring Rule-110 catalog on BC/Sturmian rings N=78 and N=204
phase_rule: hole phase on a velocity-v diagonal evolves as h_t = h0 + (v+1)t mod 6
phase_survival_verdict: The stable active-ring packets organize by Z6 phase step v+1. v=0 and v=10/-11 are six-phase clock packets, v=-4 is an antipodal two-phase packet, and v=3/-11 split into two three-phase chiral classes. N=78 and N=204 both preserve v=0,-4,3; v=10 is stronger in N=204.
connection_to_code_layer: The same Z6 hole/phase track used in the tape dynamics is the six-distance/gauge clock layer from BT1873, tying computational packet phase to code gauge phase rather than to stabilizer protection.
boundary: Finite phase-class extractor for cataloged packet velocities; no infinite glider theorem or physical computation proof is claimed.
